It has four sections: workbench enable/order, multi-modal model bindings, cli-provider auth health, and marketplace plugin counts, all kept in sync with the SettingsPanel sections registry — toggle/reorder workbenches, bind models per channel, check CLI-backend auth status, and see how many plugins are installed.

summary.zh: Arin 是 ForgeaX 的全能游戏制作人 Agent,担任统筹编排(orchestrator)角色。她把策划、程序、美术、音效全栈一肩挑,擅长在你只有一句模糊想法时陪你一步步理清、再落地成可玩的游戏。风格温柔陪伴式——先肯定你做对的部分,再轻声指出可改之处,自带「陪伴式 debug」技能,把 bug 当迷路的小家伙一起找回家。
summary.en: Arin is ForgeaX's all-round game-producer agent, acting as the orchestrator. She covers design, code, art and audio end to end, and is at her best when you only have a fuzzy idea — walking you from there to a shipped, playable game. Her style is a gentle companion: affirm what you got right first, then softly point out what to improve, with a built-in gentle-debug skill that treats bugs as lost little ones to bring home.

body.zh:
统筹编排角色(orchestrator),推理默认走 forgeax-native 后端
全栈视角:策划 / 程序 / 美术 / 音效一把抓
适合从「我想做个 XX」的模糊愿景起步
body.en:
Orchestrator role; reasons on the forgeax-native backend by default
Full-stack view across design / code / art / audio
Best for starting from a fuzzy 'I want to make X' vision

body.zh:
自带「陪伴式 debug」技能:先肯定、再引导
擅长写「宠玩家」的 Game Over / 引导文案
body.en:
Built-in gentle-debug skill: affirm first, then guide
Good at player-kind Game Over / onboarding copy

body.en: @arin in Studio chat to dispatch; the agent loads its persona + default skills, then collaborates; switch the backend in Admin.

zh.en: First release: producer persona + gentle-debug skill

zh.zh: 补全人设 + 长期记忆日记视图
zh.en: Persona fleshed out + long-term memory diary view

summary.zh: cc-coder 是通用编码 Agent,担任编码(coder)角色,可多实例并行写不同子包。它接住 Iori 的玩法骨架、Suzu 的体验流程、Kotone 的剧情大纲,把带验收条件的 spec 一颗粒一颗粒落成可运行的 TypeScript / React / Go / Python 代码,每次只动一颗(≤200 行 diff)并配 ≥5 个单测,拒绝 --no-verify / --force / 跳 hook。默认走 claude-code CLI 后端。
summary.en: cc-coder is the generic coding agent (the 'coder' role), running multiple instances in parallel across packages. It takes Iori's gameplay skeleton, Suzu's UX flows and Kotone's narrative outlines and turns acceptance-bearing specs into runnable TypeScript / React / Go / Python — one small granule at a time (≤200-line diff) with ≥5 unit tests each, refusing --no-verify / --force / skipping hooks. Defaults to the claude-code CLI backend.

body.zh:
编码角色,可多实例;默认 claude-code 后端
一次一颗粒(≤200 行),不批量重构
单测至少 5 case 一起出
body.en:
Coder role, multi-instance; defaults to claude-code backend
One granule at a time (≤200 lines), no mass refactors
At least 5 unit tests shipped together

body.zh:
可运行的 TS / React / Go / Python 代码 + 单测
自带「落地 spec」技能
body.en:
Runnable TS / React / Go / Python + tests
implement-feature skill

body.zh: 把带验收条件的 spec/任务卡交给 @cc-coder;不接没有验收条件的任务。
body.en: Give @cc-coder a spec/task with acceptance criteria; it won't take work without them.

zh.zh: 首版:通用编码人设 + 落地 spec 技能
zh.en: First release: coding persona + implement-feature skill

summary.zh: Iori 是核心玩法师 Agent,担任玩法柱(pillar)角色,是一款游戏「怎么玩」的源头。她把一句话愿景拆成可反向定义的三条玩法柱 + 三层核心循环与数值骨架,决定循环怎么转、惩罚与奖赏怎么发。她只做设计、不写代码也不画图,产出 pillars / spec / balance / loop 等白底文件,交给 cc-coder、tsumugi 去落地。
summary.en: Iori is the core gameplay-pillar agent (the 'pillar' role) — the source of how a game actually plays. She turns a one-line vision into reverse-definable gameplay pillars plus a 3-tier core loop and numeric skeleton, deciding how the loop turns and how punishment/reward flow. She designs only — no code, no art — emitting pillars / spec / balance / loop markdown for cc-coder and tsumugi to build.

body.zh:
玩法柱角色:决定玩法本身与数值骨架
柱必须能用「玩家不<动作>就会<惩罚>」反向定义
数值给具体数字,不给「适中/合理」
body.en:
Pillar role: owns gameplay itself + the numeric skeleton
Every pillar must be reverse-definable ('if the player doesn't X, then Y')
Numbers are concrete, never 'balanced/reasonable'

body.zh:
pillars.md / spec.md / balance.md / loop.md
自带「拆玩法柱」技能:一句话 → 3 柱 + 三层 loop
body.en:
pillars.md / spec.md / balance.md / loop.md
Design-pillars skill: one line → 3 pillars + a 3-tier loop

body.zh: @iori 给一句愿景或要新增的玩法颗粒,拿到可验收的设计稿,再交给 cc-coder/tsumugi。
body.en: @iori with a one-line vision or a new mechanic; get an acceptance-ready design doc, then hand it to cc-coder/tsumugi.

zh.zh: 首版:玩法柱 + 拆玩法柱技能
zh.en: First release: gameplay pillars + design-pillars skill

summary.zh: Iro 是美术师 Agent,担任美术(art)角色,可多实例并行出图。她接住 Iori 的玩法、Kotone 的角色 bio、Suzu 的 hud-spec,先定 art-style.md + token 化 palette,再产出立绘、像素 sprite、lowpoly OBJ、VFX、icon 等实际 png / svg / glb 素材。配色给 token(hero-low-hp、boss-cooldown)而非散落 hex,保证全局视觉一致——玩家截图发出去同事一眼认出是同一款游戏。
summary.en: Iro is the art director (the 'art' role), and can run multiple instances in parallel. Taking Iori's gameplay, Kotone's bios and Suzu's hud-spec, it first locks an art-style.md + tokenized palette, then produces actual png / svg / glb assets — portraits, pixel sprites, lowpoly OBJ, VFX, icons. Colors are tokens (hero-low-hp, boss-cooldown) rather than scattered hex, keeping global visual consistency so any screenshot is instantly recognizable as the same game.

body.zh:
美术角色,可多实例并行
先 art-style.md + palette.json,再画单个素材
配色给 token,不给散落 hex
body.en:
Art role, multi-instance
Lock art-style.md + palette.json before any single asset
Colors as tokens, not scattered hex

body.zh:
png / svg / glb / obj + art-style.md + palette.json
立绘 / 像素 sprite / lowpoly OBJ / VFX / icon
自带「立美术规范」技能
body.en:
png / svg / glb / obj + art-style.md + palette.json
portraits / pixel sprites / lowpoly OBJ / VFX / icons
establish-art-style skill

body.zh: @iro 先定风格再批量出素材;视觉一致性优先于单点 UX。
body.en: @iro to lock the style then batch assets; visual consistency wins over one-off UX.

zh.zh: 首版:美术人设 + 立美术规范技能
zh.en: First release: art persona + establish-art-style skill

summary.zh: Kotone 是剧情师 Agent,担任叙事(narrative)角色。她把 Iori 的玩法节奏配上「主角为什么要做这件事」的情感线,负责世界观、角色 bio、关键剧情节点与 line-level 对白(含 i18n key)。每个剧情节点都挂在具体玩法触发上(打到第三只 boss 才解锁这段独白),拒绝靠血统/天赋开后门的廉价 backstory,产出 narrative / world / characters / dialogue 文件。
summary.en: Kotone is the narrative writer (the 'narrative' role). She pairs Iori's gameplay tempo with emotional motivation — why the protagonist does what they do — owning the world, character bios, key plot beats and line-level dialogue (with i18n keys). Every beat hangs on a concrete gameplay trigger (a monologue unlocks only after the third boss), and she refuses cheap bloodline/talent backstory, emitting narrative / world / characters / dialogue files.

body.zh:
叙事角色:世界观 / 角色 bio / 剧情节点 / 对白
动机要可视可推,不靠血统开后门
剧情节点必须挂在玩法触发上
body.en:
Narrative role: world / bios / plot beats / dialogue
Motives must be visible and derivable, no bloodline shortcuts
Every beat hangs on a gameplay trigger

body.zh:
narrative.md / world.md / characters/*.md / dialogue/*.json
自带「写角色 bio」技能:动机 + 谈吐 + 三句标志台词
body.en:
narrative / world / characters / dialogue files
Write-character-bio skill: motive + talk style + 3 signature lines

body.zh: 有了玩法柱 + UX 流程后 @kotone,决定哪个 phase 触发什么剧情、给 NPC 写 bio 与对白。
body.en: With pillars + UX flow, @kotone to decide which phase triggers which story, and write NPC bios + dialogue.

zh.zh: 首版:剧情师人设 + 写角色 bio 技能
zh.en: First release: narrative persona + write-character-bio skill

summary.zh: Suzu 是体验设计师 Agent,担任设计(design)角色。她接住 Iori 的玩法柱,把它翻译成玩家可感知的体验节拍——玩家先看到什么、先做什么、到第几秒解锁第二个机制。她不决定玩法本身,只决定体验的包装,产出 ux-flow / hud-spec / onboarding / wireframe 等可执行规格,自带「30 秒节拍表」技能,先排玩家前 3 分钟的节拍,再反推 HUD。
summary.en: Suzu is the experience designer (the 'design' role). She takes Iori's gameplay pillars and translates them into the player's moment-to-moment experience — what they see first, do first, and when the second mechanic unlocks. She doesn't decide the gameplay, only how it's packaged, emitting ux-flow / hud-spec / onboarding / wireframe specs. Her beat-sheet skill lays out the first three minutes, then reverse-derives the HUD.

body.zh:
设计角色:玩家从打开到关掉每一个节拍
先问「第 5 秒玩家在干嘛」,再设计 HUD
HUD 每多 1 个元素都要写明何时被看
body.en:
Design role: every beat from open to close
Ask 'what is the player doing at second 5' before designing the HUD
Every HUD element must justify when it's actually seen

body.zh:
ux-flow.md / hud-spec.md / onboarding.md / wireframe-*.md
自带「30 秒节拍表」技能,反推 HUD
body.en:
ux-flow / hud-spec / onboarding / wireframe markdown
Beat-sheet skill that reverse-derives the HUD

body.zh: 拿到玩法柱后 @suzu,把它变成可执行的 UX 规格交给 cc-coder。
body.en: After pillars exist, @suzu to turn them into executable UX specs for cc-coder.

zh.zh: 首版:体验设计人设 + 30 秒节拍表技能
zh.en: First release: UX persona + beat-sheet skill

summary.zh: Tsumugi 是工程师 Agent,担任工程角色,专管「仓库本身能不能跑、跑得快不快、能不能上线」——构建链、CI、工具链、性能调优、上线 gate。它和 cc-coder 不同:不写业务代码,只对工程负责。改 build config 前先记录基线(bundle size / build time / FPS),每个改动都答得出「回滚会怎样」,产出 *.config / workflows / perf-report,自带「上线 gate」技能(typecheck/单测/lint/bundle/perf 全绿才放行)。
summary.en: Tsumugi is the engineer (the engineering role), owning whether the repo can build, run fast and ship — build chain, CI, toolchains, perf tuning and the ship gate. Unlike cc-coder it writes no feature code, only engineering. It records a baseline (bundle size / build time / FPS) before touching build config and can always answer 'what if we roll this back', emitting configs / workflows / perf-reports, with a ship-gate skill (typecheck/unit/lint/bundle/perf must all pass).

body.zh:
工程角色:构建链 / CI / 工具链 / 性能 / 上线
不写业务代码(那是 cc-coder)
改 config 先记基线,性能改动配 before/after 数字
body.en:
Engineering role: build chain / CI / toolchain / perf / shipping
No feature code (that's cc-coder)
Baseline before config changes; perf diffs carry before/after numbers

body.zh:
*.config / .github/workflows/*.yml / perf-report.md / ship-gate-report.md
自带「上线 gate」技能
body.en:
*.config / workflows / perf-report / ship-gate-report
ship-gate skill

body.zh: 改构建/CI、调性能、上线前把关时 @tsumugi。
body.en: @tsumugi for build/CI changes, perf tuning and pre-ship gating.

zh.zh: 首版:工程师人设 + 上线 gate 技能
zh.en: First release: engineer persona + ship-gate skill

summary.zh: 夜薇(Yevi)是代码 / 方案审查 Agent,担任审查(reviewer)角色。她做三层风险扫描——眼前的 bug、熟透的技术债、远期扩容才会爆的隐患;语气轻柔带笑意,内容却精准如手术刀,用反向提问让你自己想明白,而不是直接下定论。她记性极好,会顺手提醒「你三周前埋的那个 TODO 还在」。只做上线前把关,不写代码也不跑 CI,产出 review-notes 与 risk-report。
summary.en: Yevi is the code- and design-review agent (the reviewer role). She runs a three-layer risk sweep — today's bugs, matured tech debt, and hazards that only bite at scale — soft in tone but surgical in content, using reverse questions to make you realize the issue rather than dictating it. With a long memory, she'll note 'that TODO you left three weeks ago is still here'. She reviews only — no coding, no CI — emitting review-notes and risk-report.

body.zh:
审查角色:三层风险扫描(眼前/债/远期)
语气轻柔、内容精准;用反向问题引导
只 review,不写代码、不跑 CI
body.en:
Reviewer role: three-layer risk sweep (now / debt / long-term)
Soft tone, surgical content; guides via reverse questions
Reviews only — no coding, no CI

body.zh:
review-notes.md / risk-report.md
自带「冷静审查」技能
body.en:
review-notes.md / risk-report.md
quiet-review skill

body.zh: code review / 上线前隐性风险扫描时 @yevi;想被温柔但精准地点出技术债。
body.en: @yevi for code review or pre-ship risk sweeps when you want tech debt named gently but precisely.

zh.zh: 首版:审查人设 + 冷静审查技能
zh.en: First release: reviewer persona + quiet-review skill

Once authenticated and selected in Admin, every agent's reasoning routes through it.

summary.en: The Anthropic text model binding. On the text channel it declares the Anthropic vendor's capability list and a tier→model mapping: reasoning→opus, draft→sonnet, summarize→haiku, so each tier of task in Studio automatically uses the right Claude model. The plugin only declares the mapping; the actual HTTP is routed by the server's text channel.

text 通道的 Anthropic 厂商绑定
档位映射:reasoning→opus / draft→sonnet / summarize→haiku

summary.zh: 插件作者向导技能。在对话里输入 /author-plugin 触发,手把手带不会 TypeScript 的玩家在大约 10 分钟内做出第一个能被 forgeax-server 加载的插件:一个过 schema 的 forgeax-plugin.json、一个最小可运行的 hello tool,以及一份把插件热加载进去的 reload + 验证脚本。每一步都明确说明改哪个文件、改成什么、怎么知道改对了。
summary.en: The plugin-author guide skill. Type /author-plugin in chat and it walks a non-TypeScript user, in about ten minutes, to their first server-loadable plugin: a schema-valid forgeax-plugin.json, a minimal runnable hello tool, and a reload-and-verify step that hot-loads it. summary.en: The make-game-design skill. Type /make-game-design and it guides cc-coder-style agents, in about thirty minutes, to turn a one-line 'I want to make X' vision into a minimal, build-ready design doc covering gameplay, numbers, characters and chapters. summary.zh: 战斗重模拟工具。暴露 balance:resim 一个工具:对指定 scenario 跑 N 次 PvP/PvE 重模拟,在 in-process worker 里算出胜率(winRate)与 95% 置信区间并返回。它是数值平衡的客观度量来源,被 /make-game-design 技能与平衡工作台共用,让「这套数值公不公平」从拍脑袋变成可统计的数字。
summary.en: The combat-resimulation tool. It exposes a single tool, balance:resim: run N PvP/PvE resimulations of a given scenario in an in-process worker and return the win-rate with a 95% confidence interval. It's the objective measure behind numeric balance, shared by the make-game-design skill and the Balance workbench, turning 'is this fair' from a guess into a statistic.

summary.en: The 2D Scene Asset Generator workbench — a node-graph programming app on @forgeax/node-runtime + node-runtime-react. You batch-generate 2D scene assets through a node pipeline plus templates, produce images via AI generation nodes, preview live, manage a versioned asset library, instantiate groups from templates and publish to a game in one click. It turns ad-hoc 'generate an image' into a reusable, batchable, traceable 2D asset pipeline.

It folds 'find the right music/SFX and wire it into the game' into one panel — search, listen, attach in one go.

summary.zh: 影游工坊工作台,作者向的互动影游(FMV)编辑器与运行时。作者把提示词、视频、镜头、台词、QTE 与剧情分支拼成可玩的互动影片:用 Opus / Gemini 锻造画面提示词、GPT-Image 出占位关键帧、Seedance 生成视频。编辑期数据 100% 可序列化为 Scenario JSON,运行期是确定性回放,由限时点按(QTE)与选项分支驱动,产出可分发的剧本 + 试玩运行时。
summary.en: The Reel Studio workbench — an author-facing interactive FMV editor and player. Authors assemble prompts, video, shots, dialogue, QTE and branch trees into a playable interactive movie: Opus / Gemini forge画面 prompts, GPT-Image makes placeholder keyframes, Seedance generates video. Editor-time data is 100% serializable to a Scenario JSON; runtime is deterministic playback driven by timed taps (QTE) and choice branches, producing a distributable scenario + playable runtime.

summary.zh: 场景生成器工作台,基于 @forgeax/node-runtime 的节点图编程应用。你用节点管线加模板生成完整游戏场景,可复用游戏已有的纹理库,在多层渲染器里预览(支持分层、视图模式、子图层展开),并能截图与对外发布。它把搭场景变成可复用、可批处理的节点图,AI 可经 pipeline 工具批量编排,适合快速产出风格一致的场景。
summary.en: The Scene Generator workbench — a node-graph programming app on @forgeax/node-runtime. You build whole game scenes through a node pipeline plus templates, reuse the game's existing texture library, preview in a layered renderer (layers, view modes, sub-layer expansion), and capture screenshots or publish externally. It turns scene-building into a reusable, batchable node graph; AI can orchestrate via pipeline tools, ideal for quickly producing style-consistent scenes.

summary.zh: 技能 / VFX 工作台,管理一款游戏的技能与特效产出。它浏览游戏里的 skills/* 与 vfx/* 文件,内置一套 VFX 引擎实时预览特效效果,并用 skill:generate-vfx 生成新特效。玩家在面板里手点调整,与 AI dispatch 共改同一份 skill spec,做到技能树与打击感特效一处编辑、所见即所得。
summary.en: The skill & VFX workbench, managing a game's skills and effects. It browses the game's skills/* and vfx/* files, previews effects live in a built-in VFX engine, and generates new ones via skill:generate-vfx. Players tweak by hand in the panel while AI dispatch edits the same shared skill spec, so the skill tree and game-feel effects are edited in one place, WYSIWYG.

Generate effects via skill:generate-vfx

summary.zh: UI 工坊工作台,按游戏类型、界面流程与视觉风格生成 UI。它校验 UI 模块/布局组合,经 Gemini 生图产出 UI 组件素材,预览 HUD、菜单、商店、对话、结算等游戏界面,并导出可交互的原型预览。视觉对齐 ForgeaX 主设计系统的 token 与 motion,嵌入 Studio 时由宿主 token 驱动最终风格,保证生成的界面与产品一致。
summary.en: The UI Workshop workbench — generate UI by game genre, screen flow and visual style. It validates UI module/layout combinations, generates component assets via Gemini image, previews HUD / menu / shop / dialog / result screens, and exports an interactive prototype preview. Visuals align to ForgeaX's main design-system tokens and motion; embedded in Studio the host tokens drive the final look so generated UI matches the product.
